facts.fact: The World Bank's WDI lists 2013 as the year of Gabon's latest population census.
The World Bank's WDI lists the Troisieme Enquete Demographique et de Sante 2019-2021 as Gabon's latest demographic, education or health household survey.
facts.system: Troisieme Enquete Demographique et de Sante 2019-2021

facts.fact: The World Bank's WDI lists a Living Standards Measurement Study / integrated household survey of 2017 as the source of Gabon's most recent income and expenditure data.
